Traditional antidepressants often work less effectively for these individuals, potentially explaining why some people struggle to find relief.

articles.title: Earth's next ice age may have already begun. Global warming stopped it
articles.description: Scientists have uncovered surprising evidence that Earth’s next ice age may have already begun, only to be stopped by global warming. But by the 1960s, rising temperatures had reversed that growth, causing the ice to shrink instead.
